query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

messages.content: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

message.content:
In Massachusetts, the **maximum weekly unemployment benefit** is **$1,105 per week**. If you’re approved, you can receive benefits for **up to 30 weeks** in a benefit year, subject to your eligibility and wage history.[2][4]

Your actual amount is usually about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at that maximum, and Massachusetts says your total benefit year limit is the smaller of **30 times your weekly benefit amount** or **36% of your total wages in the base period**.[4]

If you want, I can also help estimate **your** unemployment amount from your recent wages.
